name: 07072 · Carlstadt, NJ
findings: ZIP 07072 (Carlstadt) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07072 (Carlstadt) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07072 (Carlstadt) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
